description: A cream canvas tote with dark straps and a red “Trader Joe’s” logo sits on a pink bed, with a small yellow rubber duck off to the right. The left hand reaches in from the left to grab the tote, then the right hand joins so the tote becomes a two-hand object as both hands lift it upright, pull the opening wide, and reach inside to adjust or remove a dark item before setting the tote back down open.
